auth.description: Visit your Cody AI API Keys page to retrieve the API key.

create_document_from_text.name: create_document_from_text
create_document_from_text.description: Upload text content to create a new document within the Cody knowledge base.

name.description: The name or title of the new document.

content.description: The text or HTML content to be added to the document. Max 768 KB.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new document in a Cody knowledge base folder from raw text or HTML content, so the bot can later answer from it. Use when ingesting inline/generated text (not a file upload). Requires a target folder ID and the content (max 768 KB); creates a new document on each call, so it is not idempotent.

upload_file.name: upload_file
upload_file.description: Add a file directly into a specific folder in the knowledge base.

file.description: The file to upload (e.g., txt, md, rtf, pdf, ppt, docx).

aiMetadata.description: Uploads a binary file (e.g. txt, md, rtf, pdf, ppt, docx) into a Cody knowledge base folder via a signed URL, then registers it as a document. Use when ingesting an existing file rather than inline text. Requires a target folder ID and the file; creates a new document each call, so it is not idempotent.

send_message.name: send_message
send_message.description: Send your message and receive the AI-generated response.

content.description: The message to send to the conversation. (Max 2000 characters)

aiMetadata.description: Posts a message to an existing Cody conversation and returns the bot AI-generated reply. Use to query a bot within an already-created conversation thread. Requires the conversation ID and message text (max 2000 characters); each call appends a new message, so it is not idempotent.

create_conversation.name: create_conversation
create_conversation.description: Creates a new conversation with a bot.

name.description: The name for the new conversation.

document_ids.description: A list of document IDs to limit the bot's knowledge base for this conversation.

aiMetadata.description: Starts a new conversation thread with a specific Cody bot, returning a conversation ID to use with Send Message. Optionally pass a list of document IDs to scope the bot knowledge base to just those documents (focus mode). Requires a bot ID and a name; creates a new conversation each call, so it is not idempotent.

find_bot.name: find_bot
find_bot.description: Finds a bot based on its name.

name.description: The name of the bot to search for. The search is case-insensitive and partial.

aiMetadata.description: Searches Cody bots by name (case-insensitive partial match) and returns the matches. Use to resolve a bot name to its ID before creating a conversation. This is a read-only lookup and is idempotent.

find_conversation.name: find_conversation
find_conversation.description: Finds a conversation based on its name and/or the bot it belongs to.

name.description: The name of the conversation to search for (partial match).

aiMetadata.description: Searches Cody conversations, filtering by owning bot ID and/or by name (partial match) and returns the matches. Use to resolve an existing conversation to its ID. At least one of bot or name must be provided. This is a read-only lookup and is idempotent.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

auth.description: Visit your Cody AI API Keys page to retrieve the API key.

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
